heading: Something is being built here for the people who go quiet in the chair.
body: The Unmasked Standard is a certification for salons, spas and studios that want their neurodivergent and trauma-impacted guests to stop masking through appointments and start coming back. It is a floor protocol, not a workshop. Written on a real floor, in London Ontario, over two and a half years.
promise: Leave your email and you will hear from us once when it opens. Not before, and not weekly.
captureFineprint: One email when it opens. Nothing else, and nothing sold to anyone.
successMessage: Thank you. You will hear from us once, when it is ready.
